title: THE WATCHMAN KNOWS. (four boxes came in this week. he isn't telling.)
format: carousel, 7 slides at 1080x1440: S1 video loop 10.0 s (300 frames, frame 299 leading into frame 0; frame 0 = the cover = the grid tile, C-WORLD at scale 1 on r4c1), S2-S5 video loops 9.0 s (270 frames: front 0-1.4 s, turn 1.4-2.3 s, back held 2.3-7.2 s, turn back 7.2-8.1 s, front 8.1-9.0 s), S6-S7 stills. Video: H.264 High yuv420p 30 fps, one GOP at the QP each wrap needs (S1 1, S2-S3 8, S4-S5 6), IDR at frame 0 only, AAC 48 kHz stereo (baked foley), +faststart (moov before mdat).

sources.rebuild: cd render/v3/p03 && TMPDIR=/dev/shm/p03tmp FR=/dev/shm bash tools/build.sh [s01|tags|stills|all]   (frames.cjs captures each loop into $FR, encode.sh encodes it with the exact seam and muxes the foley, render.cjs + export.py make the stills and cover.jpg / cover-thumb.png, strip.py the beat strips; a failed capture or render now stops the build; FR defaults to _build/, TMPDIR to /tmp); mattes: python3 -I _build/rematte.py <key>; the desk plate: python3 -I _build/retouch_ai08.py; the kandil lit / unlit measurement: node _build/klit.cjs <outdir>
sources.rematte: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/aceb438e-f1c8-5500-8bc9-95c87202d43a/scratchpad/feed/render/v3/p03/_build/rematte.py (originals in _build/orig/: the 1400 px Shopify fetch cutouts.py made, plus BiRefNet soft alpha)
sources.plate: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/aceb438e-f1c8-5500-8bc9-95c87202d43a/scratchpad/feed/render/v3/p03/plates/AI-08b.png  (AI-08 with the bell cloned out; recipe _build/retouch_ai08.py, registered in the bay as NV.AI['AI-08b'])
sources.glint_check: node _build/glint/cap.cjs s0N.html <capdir> 84 129 (on tmpfs; renders frames 84-129 as shipped, band alone, and neither), then python3 -I _build/glint/check.py <capdir> s0N.mp4 s0N and python3 -I _build/glint/stones.py <capdir> (S5); results in _build/glint/check-s0N.json and stones-s05.json. The pre-pass tagslide.js, s03.html, post.json, s02-s05.mp4 and strips are kept in _build/pre-glint/.

caption:
The week before Diwali, at the gate. Four boxes came in for the building, and the watchman knows exactly who each one is for.

101, for Aai: Duo Link Necklace, ₹1,299. 203, for the one with your spare key: Ribbon Bead Bracelet, ₹799. 202, for the evening walk: Woven Gold Hoops, ₹1,299. And you: Prism Rivière Bracelet, ₹2,399.

Every piece arrives in the blush Naira box. Take 2 pieces for 10% off or 3 for 20% off. The bag applies BUY2 or BUY3 for you.

[ four gifts in four blush boxes · gold tone and rhodium · he isn't telling ]
first_comment: Tag the neighbour who has your spare key. Every piece arrives in our blush box · free insured shipping · COD available #NairaFlore #DiwaliGifting #GiftsForHer #DemiFineJewellery #NairaPetite
alt_text: Short looping video. An illustrated pink Art Deco building entrance with the Naira wordmark in brass letters on its arch and sage iron gates folded open. In the sage lobby, under a tube light: THE WATCHMAN KNOWS, and 'four boxes came in this week. he isn't telling.' On two small teak shelves on wall brackets stand three blush gift boxes, end on, each with a paper tag hanging from it reading 101, 203 and 202. On the watchman's desk, on an open blank register, a blush box with a paper strip reading YOU along its lid has its drawer open on a bracelet of pastel aqua, pink and yellow stones. A draught moves one gate, sets the three tags swinging in turn and lifts the corner of the register's page, which settles again; then a glint of light crosses the bracelet. A pink paper lantern turns slowly at the left; a brass plate below reads THE GATE.

Short looping video on a sage background. An ivory parcel tag hangs on a gold cord and reads FLAT 101. It turns over: 'for aai, who says never mix your metals. we mixed them, politely.' Then it turns back. Below it lies a necklace of long oval links, some gold tone and some silver tone, joined by small stacked gold rings, and a glint crosses it. Duo Link Necklace, ₹1,299. Two tone, 45 cm.

Short looping video on a sage background. An ivory parcel tag hangs on a gold cord and reads FLAT 203. It turns over: 'for the neighbour who has had your spare key since 2014. she gets the hearts. two of them.' Below it lies a fine gold tone chain bracelet with small beads and, at its centre, two heart-shaped clear stones set side by side like a bow. Ribbon Bead Bracelet, ₹799. Two heart-cut stones that read as a bow, adjusts 16 to 19 cm.

Short looping video on a sage background. An ivory parcel tag hangs on a gold cord and reads FLAT 202. It turns over: 'for the friend from the evening walk. she asks every night where your hoops are from.' Below it, a pair of chunky braided gold tone hoop earrings, one standing and one lying on its side. Woven Gold Hoops, ₹1,299. 18k gold tone plated, about 25 mm.

Short looping video on a sage background. An ivory parcel tag hangs on a gold cord and reads YOU. It turns over: 'you signed for this one yourself.' Below it lies a silver tone bracelet of square pastel stones in aqua, pink and pale yellow, each framed in tiny clear stones. Prism Rivière Bracelet, ₹2,399. Pastel cubic zirconia, rhodium plated.
Photograph: the closed blush pink Naira gift box, the wordmark on its lid, resting on soft blush silk. Text: EVERY PIECE ARRIVES IN THIS.

End card on blush plaster: a brass plate with the Naira wordmark, then THE GATE · GROUND FLOOR, INWARD · FOUR BOXES, [ 18k gold tone plated · two tone · rhodium plated ], and the watchman's four entries as a price list: 101 · aai · duo link necklace, ₹1,299; 203 · the spare key · ribbon bead bracelet, ₹799; 202 · the evening walk · woven gold hoops, ₹1,299; gate · you · prism rivière bracelet, ₹2,399. Then 'four boxes, one gate, nobody told.', nairaflore.com, and every piece arrives in our blush box · free insured shipping · COD available.
sound: In-app (optional): a light santoor instrumental from the Instagram audio library, no vocals, no lyrics, kept under the baked foley. BAKED (synthesised, _build/sfx.py, very soft, every file starts and ends in digital silence so the loops are seamless): S1 (10.0 s) 1.0 s a soft gust through the gate (swells over 0.6 s, gone by ~2.6 s, low-passed, peak -30 dBFS), 2.6 s a page flutter as the register's corner lifts (three dry rustles spread over its 0.8 s rise, -29 dBFS), 4.3 s one soft, dull paper tap as it settles (-36 dBFS), 6.4 s one small glass ting as the glint crosses the Prism (-24 dBFS). S2-S5 (9.0 s each): one soft paper flick as the tag turns over at 1.4 s (-27 dBFS), nothing on the turn back at 7.2 s, silence through the 4.9 s hold.
deviations: DIRECTOR'S SERIES FIX 3 (27 Oct), S6's foot DROPPED rather than replaced. The fix offered two choices: set the house service line ('every piece arrives in our blush box · free insured shipping · COD available', Jost 400 22 ink soft), or drop the foot because S7 already carries it. Rendered with the house line (Jost 400 22 #3D3530, tracked .06em, centred, baseline 1366), the slide says 'every piece arrives' twice, under the headline EVERY PIECE / ARRIVES IN THIS. The house line is also faint at 22 px over the folds of silk. S7, one swipe later, sets the house line word for word at baseline 1300, so shipping and COD are still in the carousel. BRIEF NOT EDITED: this pass may edit only p03/ and world/bays/p03.js. briefs/option-v3.json post 3 still lists the old foot in two places. In 'concept' (EVERY WORD ON SCREEN), delete ", 'FREE INSURED SHIPPING · CASH ON DELIVERY AVAILABLE'" after "S6 'EVERY PIECE' / 'ARRIVES IN THIS.'". In 'carousel_slides' S6, delete "; foot 'FREE INSURED SHIPPING · CASH ON DELIVERY AVAILABLE' Jost 500 24 tracked .2em ink, baseline 1366". The first comment still reads 'Free insured shipping · Cash on delivery available': it is not on a slide and was not in this fix list, so it is left for the director (see director_series_fixes_27oct).

FINAL REVIEW GLINT, S3's travel (the one place fix 1's numbers are not used as written): with S1's travel across the whole cut-out (82.8 - 64.7 inout(g)) the band was on S3's metal for 13 frames (3.367-3.767 s, 0.433 s), under check (a)'s 0.5 s. S3's glint is masked to native y > 300 (round 2 fix 2: the soft-focus back arc stays unlit), so it can light only the front chain, native x 37-780 of 822 and about 40 px tall, and gets neither the cut-out's full width nor the extra reach the band's 15 deg lean gives a tall piece. So S3 runs S1's travel across that span: centre x = x0 + (x1 - x0)(-0.155 + 1.294 inout(g)), i.e. (79.75 - 58.48 inout(g))%, set by "glintSpan": [37, 780] in s03.html, its sparkles timed on the same span. Result: 16 frames (0.533 s), at a pace within 10 % of S1's, 2.85 % of pixels over 40 at most. S2, S4 and S5 carry no span and use the review's numbers exactly. To go back to the literal numbers on S3: delete glintSpan from s03.html and run tools/build.sh tags.

FINAL REVIEW GLINT, three small notes. 82.8 is kept as written; it starts the band at W(-0.156) rather than -0.155 (82.75 would be exact), a difference of 0.001 W, under 1 px. The glint layer's initial background-position, seen only at opacity 0, moved from 120 % to 82.8 % to match the new start (no pixel changes). The S2-S5 strips' beats (tools/build.sh) are now 3.4 glint enters, 3.55 glint + sparkles, 3.75 glint leaves (were 3.4 glint, 3.6 sparkle; 7.0 back held dropped to keep 14 tiles), so the slower crossing shows in the strip.

ROUND 3 FIX 4 (kandil y 268) APPLIED IN THE BAY, NOT IN SHARED CODE: B.gate (world/builders2.js) still says F.bracket(p, 140, 300) and b.kandil({x: 140, y: 300}); this pass may edit only the bay and p03/, so p03.js re-lays both after B.gate builds them: the bracket layer (.p-bracket) is redrawn with F.bracket(p, 140, 268) on the arch's lower step face, and the kandil is re-created from its own opts with y 268 as the bay's last layer, exactly where B.gate laid it, so the world's kandil handle, sage pool, veil and wedding holes all use the new one. It is guarded (if the gate already lays it at 268 it does nothing), so the world lead can change the two numbers in builders2.js at any time with no double move. The brief (briefs/option-v3.json, C-KANDIL / system.emblem) is also outside this pass's files and still reads 'from the gate arch's bracket at y 300 on P3': the owner of the brief should change it to 'at y 268 on P3'.

ROUND 3 FIX 2 (the bell): AI-08b lives in p03/plates/AI-08b.png and is registered by the bay (NV.AI['AI-08b'] = AI-08's size and content box with its own src), not added to world.js's plate table or the shared assets folder. Made by clone-and-heal (_build/retouch_ai08.py): the bell's zone (its silhouette grown 28 px, its reflection in the polish, the soft shadow it threw right and down) filled from clean desk nearby (the far-edge strip shifted along the edge with a per-column nudge so the edge runs on unbroken and transparent behind; the rest in four patches from 230-500 px away, off the register, the bullnose and the desk's two scratches), then one Poisson solve guided by the sources' high-pass gradients. Outside the zone AI-08b is AI-08 pixel for pixel (RGB and alpha), so DESK0 (-118, 804), the page flap and the turn's clearance are unchanged.

ROUND 3 FIX 1 (the YOU strip) is drawn by the bay, not by the kit: kit/box.js lays its strip along the lid's y edge with no option to turn it, so P3's box is made with print: false, strip: null and the bay adds the same 300 x 110 strip (Jost 500 40, tracked .3em, the kit's ivory and hairline) in the lid's own projection with its long axis along +x, centred on the lid, plus a 22 % hairline shadow toward +x/+y. No lid print is drawn on the YOU box at all.

S2-S5 PERSPECTIVE 2200 px, not 1400 (at 1400 the near edge of the 680 px card ballooned mid-turn); the face toward the viewer is switched in script at 90 deg (Chromium drew the far face mirrored through the near one under the faces' multiply shade). Timings are now the director's round 3 spec exactly (no deviation).

FIX 7 THE DESK is 1160 px across as asked but its content box sits at tile (-118, 804), not hung from the plate's right edge (content left -156 at y 792). Hung from the right edge at y 792 its far edge runs through 'he isn't telling.'; lowered until it clears the turn (y >= 850) the register's free edge comes out only under the drawer's END face, whose steep foot leaves a page flap too narrow to lift (about 10 px at 25 deg), so fix 1 would fail. At (-118, 804) (the bell that sat behind the left leaf is cloned out of the plate in round 3, AI-08b): the far edge is 14 px under the turn's glyph boxes, and the free edge comes out from under the drawer's long foot. The plate's right edge (x 1042) is behind the right pier; the lobby clips at 930.

FIX 1 THE FLAP is not at x 556-640: that was where the free edge met the step on the 860 px desk; on the 1160 px desk it comes out from under the drawer's foot at (421, 1154) and meets the step at (441, 1196), against the register's dark cover and the teak. Fold 6 deg (not along the free edge), so the flap is large enough to read: everything between the free edge and the fold, on below the step, rises toward the viewer; the part below the step rises into view at the peak. Peak 25 deg (the top of the asked 22-25).

FIX 4 THE MINIS' SIDE (and, from the final review, a plain top, no print) is multiplied with the paperboard tooth at .28, not .40: .28 is the kit's PB_A on every box face including the YOU box's side, and world fix 13 caps it at .30. Each mini has its end face and pull tab, the sleeve's side face and a plain top (the parallelogram back 17 px and up 7 from the end face's top edge, the kit's lid gradient #F2DED8 -> #E6CCC5 x the same tooth at .28, a 1 px #F6E2DC front edge), with no print on it, so no lid print shows. The top's front edge is drawn on the top's own front row (y = end-face top - 0.5), not the asked end-face top + 0.5: that row belongs to the end face, which is drawn after the top, is opaque and already carries its #FFF1EC highlight there, so a line on it changed 0 px (measured against the same frame with the line buried under the face); one row up it reads as the top's lit edge. The boards also gained their top (as deep as a mini, rising as its side does, #7C4836) and right end (#4A2619): a side face rising off a front-on board stood over the sage, not on the board. The lower board is 566-816 (final review; it was 566-828), so its top's back corner is at 833, 13 px of sage clear of the right leaf (846) at rest and more while the draught opens it (at 828 the corner, 845, sat 1 px off the leaf: a tangency on the cover). The 202 mini still stands wholly on it (its side's foot (808, 690) -> (825, 683) lies inside the top's front edge to 816 and back edge to 833); the right gusset follows the board's end.

FIX 2 / 3 MATTES live in p03/cut/, not in the shared cutouts/ folder (this pass edits only the bay and p03/). They are on 00-trim's grid (same size and placement), so another post can use them or the lead can promote them to cutouts/<key>/00-aa-trim.png with a README line; recipe and originals in p03/_build/. Made from the ORIGINAL Shopify photographs (re-fetched exactly as cutouts.py did: the hoops and necklace RGB identical to 00.png inside the matte, the bracelet within 13 levels) and BiRefNet's own soft alpha, because 00.png keeps no RGB outside its binary matte to decontaminate from.

FIX 2 S3's glint mask runs from native y 300 (nothing) to 340 (full), a 40 px ramp, not a hard cut at 300; S2, S4 and S5 keep the tight second contact shadow (their mattes are sharp all round; only S3 drops it, as asked). The slides' contact shadow is now drawn as the piece's silhouette in its own element (same offset, blur and colour as the old CSS drop-shadow), so S3's can be masked.

THE TAGS hang from the minis' ribbon pull tabs on gold threads (the brief's 'from each pull tab an ivory 54 x 34 tag on a gold thread', Jost 500 18), replacing the world's brass label holders on the board edge, so the draught can flutter them; each turns about its thread's top (h.p3.tag).

THE PRISM IN THE YOU BOX is seated 18 px left / 21 px up of the bed's centre (offset -14, -19): at the centre the near wall hid the whole front row of pastel stones. Scale unchanged (0.278; the world review's box size and drawer 75 % kept).
THE GATE LEAF moves 4 deg FURTHER OPEN (the draught pushing it in), in the gate's own orthographic swing (scaleX(cos)), so it narrows and back rather than swinging over the lobby.

S2-S5 TAG is 680 x 380 (x 200-880, y 56-436), not 600 x 360, and the backs are Cormorant italic 40, not 42: 'for the friend from the evening walk.' measures 613 px at 42, wider than the brief's card. Fronts stay Velista 110.

S7 entries are Cormorant italic 34, not 38, and the prices Jost 500 32, not 34 (at 38 the longest entry ran into its price at x 1000); the lockup is centred on the page's writing area (x 598), not on the slide.

LOOP SEAMS (superseded by series fix S3, 27 Oct; was: 'the last frame of every loop is the captured frame 0 (the same state by construction); decoded last frame vs frame 0: max difference 0 on all five loops'): every loop is now 30 x L frames, frame n at t = n / 30 s, so no frame repeats frame 0 and the last frame leads into frame 0 by one ordinary step. s01.mp4 300 frames, s02-s05.mp4 270 each; render/v3/tools/loopseam.py passes all five (series_fixes_27oct).
FOLEY is synthesised (numpy), not from a library: there are no audio assets in the workspace.

STOCK is from roster.json (25 Oct: Duo Link 18, Ribbon Bead 34, Woven 63, Prism 67): the public Storefront token cannot read inventory. Duo Link guard: if it is below 10 on 31 Oct, swap 101's gift as the brief says.

FINAL RENDER, ON A FULL DISK: the shared disk (/) filled during this pass (63 MB, then 268 KB free while other posts rendered), and Chromium's screenshots failed ('Unable to capture screenshot', 'Target crashed'); because frames.cjs sat in an && list, build.sh carried on and left the 15:43 s01.mp4 in place. S1 was recaptured into tmpfs (/dev/shm) and every output re-checked against its timestamp. tools/build.sh now stops on a failed capture or render, takes FR (frame-dump root, default _build/) and re-synthesises the seeded foley only when sfx.py is newer than its wavs (it took ~8 min under load and its output is identical); tools/encode.sh writes its seam-check frames to $TMPDIR. Final run: TMPDIR=/dev/shm/p03tmp FR=/dev/shm bash tools/build.sh all.
checks: DIRECTOR'S SERIES FIXES (27 Oct 04:45 UTC), P3. (1) The caption's offer line is exactly 'Take 2 pieces for 10% off or 3 for 20% off. The bag applies BUY2 or BUY3 for you.' It was already in place from series fix S1, so the caption was not changed. (2) s01.mp4 was already 300 frames from series fix S3, encoded after every source it reads (latest source endcard.js 03:28, mp4 03:59), so it was NOT re-rendered. Re-verified: 300 frames, 10.000 s, one I-frame at frame 0, moov before mdat, AAC 48 kHz stereo 10.000 s. loopseam.py --frames 300: PASS, seam 0.077 vs median step 0.051 (x1.5; steps either side 0.041 / 0.072). At full size: 297->298 0.073, 298->299 0.069, 299->0 0.106, 0->1 0.101, so the wrap is an ordinary step and the last frame is not a copy of frame 0. Frames 297, 298, 299, 0 and 1 were viewed side by side at 1:1 on the kandil: it keeps turning and swaying through the wrap, with no hold. (3) s06.html's foot dropped. Re-rendered with node tools/render.cjs s06.html and python3 tools/export.py s06@2x.png, which wrote s06.jpg, s06-45.jpg, s06-thumb.png and s06@2x.png. Against the shipped s06 the change is confined to the foot's box: at 1x, x 96-984, y 1344-1368, more than 3 levels; at 2x, x 195-1965, y 2696-2734. Every other pixel is identical. Viewed: s06.jpg, s06-45.jpg, s06-thumb.png, the foot before and after at 1:1, the house-line variant (not shipped), S7's foot (the house line at 1300), cover.jpg and cover-thumb.png. Untouched (md5 as before): s01-s05.mp4, s01.jpg = cover.jpg, cover-thumb.png, s07, the strips and world/bays/p03.js. Before-state: scratchpad/p03fix/s27/before/.

FINAL REVIEW SPARKLE PASS (27 Oct 02:23 UTC), S2 only. s02.html: window.SLIDE.piece.sparks [[470, 990], [918, 330]] -> [[418, 974], [876, 268]]. Each star now lands on a gold knot, not on the sage inside a link; sparkAt follows from x (3197 and 3357 ms). TMPDIR=/dev/shm/p03tmp FR=/dev/shm bash tools/build.sh tags re-made s02.mp4 and s02-strip.jpg. _build/glint/check.py s02 (_build/glint/check-s02.json; the previous result is in _build/pre-spark/) confirms three things. (1) The sparkles peak -39 ms and +23 ms from the band's brightest moment over their new points: 1.2 and 0.7 frames, was -27 / +35. (2) The band is on the piece 0.600 s (>= 50 px) and 0.566 s (>= 0.5 %), unchanged, and 0.633 s on the mp4. (3) The decoded last frame equals frame 0, max diff 0. Viewed: frames 100-115 at 1:1 around both points, old frames 107 and 110 beside new ones, the new strip, cover.jpg and cover-thumb.png. S1, S3-S7, the cover and the thumb are as shipped (md5 unchanged). build.sh tags also re-renders S3-S5. S4 came back byte-identical. S3 and S5 differed from the shipped files in frame 43 only (1.433 s, just after the turn starts): a capture difference of up to 13 levels on 1 267 px for S3 and 2 levels on 64 px for S5. So the shipped s03.mp4 and s05.mp4 were put back byte for byte. Their strips came back byte-identical.

FINAL REVIEW GLINT PASS (27 Oct 02:00 UTC), S2-S5 only. tagslide.js: the glint's travel (82.8 - 64.7 inout(g))% = S1's own W(-0.155 + 1.294 inout(g)), 1.1 s at 3.0-4.1 s kept (S3 runs it across the chain its band may light, see deviations); the band ivory .20 / .50 and neutral .14 / .38, stops 47.5 / 49.2 / 50 / 50.8 / 52.5 % (94-109 px wide, about 0.16 W, its .20-.50-.20 core 30-35 px, like S1's 32 px band; was 170-196 px); sparkles re-timed with the review's formula. TMPDIR=/dev/shm/p03tmp FR=/dev/shm bash tools/build.sh tags re-made s02-s05.mp4 (271 frames, 9.033 s each, H.264 High yuv420p 1080x1440 30 fps, AAC 48 kHz, moov before mdat) and s02-s05-strip.jpg. S1, S6, S7, cover.jpg and cover-thumb.png are untouched (00:51 / 00:07) and were viewed again.

GLINT CROSSING, measured (frames 84-129 rendered three ways from each page: as shipped, the band alone with the sparkles hidden, and neither; piece = the cut-out's alpha > 128 at its placed size; _build/glint/check.py, results _build/glint/check-s0N.json). (a) The band alone lights >= 50 px of the piece by > 10 levels: S2 3.267-3.833 s (18 frames, 0.600 s; re-measured after the sparkle pass, unchanged), S3 3.333-3.833 (16, 0.533), S4 3.333-3.833 (16, 0.533), S5 3.333-3.800 (15, 0.500); at the stricter >= 0.5 % of the piece's pixels 0.567 / 0.500 / 0.500 / 0.500 s. The band's centre crosses the piece 3.339-3.777 s (0.438 s), exactly S1's 6.339-6.777. Before: 3.467-3.633 s, 5-6 frames (0.17-0.20 s), on all four. (b) Everything on (band + sparkles), the largest share of the piece's pixels lifted > 40 levels (any channel) in any frame of 3.0-4.1 s: S2 8.85 %, S3 2.85 %, S4 6.92 %, S5 1.54 % at the source; 8.76 / 2.87 / 6.84 / 1.50 % on the shipped mp4 (each frame against the mp4's own 2.8 s frame; noise floor <= 0.04 %). S2's figure rose from 8.33 / 8.10 % with the sparkle pass because its two stars now lie on the necklace, so the pixels they lift are piece pixels; it peaks at 3.733 s, where the band and the second star overlap. Before: 11.85 / 12.48 / 20.76 / 3.40 %. The largest frame-to-frame mean change inside 3.0-4.1 s is 0.17-0.47 levels (before 0.30-1.47). (c) Each sparkle peaks within about one frame of the band's brightest moment over its point (band alone, 24 px disc): S2 -39 / +23 ms, S3 -32 / -26, S4 +16 / -3, S5 -12 / -28 (sparkle peak minus band peak). S2's sparkle points, moved in the sparkle pass (27 Oct): native (418, 974) and (876, 268) of duo-link-necklace-aa-trim.png, the centres of two bright gold knots, on screen at (483, 1113) and (785, 647). The old points (470, 990) and (918, 330) had alpha 0, in the empty opening of a link, so each star floated on the sage. At the new points the 14 px native disc is fully opaque (alpha 255 throughout) and the pixel itself is near-white gold (255, 255, 200 and 255, 255, 225). At its peak each star now has 99.6 % and 100 % of its lit pixels on the piece. sparkAt follows from x with no other edit: 3197 and 3357 ms, was 3212 and 3380. (d) Decoded last frame == frame 0, max diff 0, on all four (encode.sh and check.py).

GLINT COLOUR, every frame 3.0-4.1 s (the band alone vs neither, on the coloured piece pixels, C* >= 20, that it lifts > 10): hue moves at most 7.7 / 10.3 / 9.0 / 6.7 deg (S2-S5, 95th percentile, worst frame), chroma kept >= 57 / 60 / 57 / 61 % (5th percentile), near-neutral (C* < 12) at most 0.17 / 0 / 0.12 / 0 %. Before, on the same measure: chroma kept down to 41 / 49 / 39 / 56 %, up to 3.0 / 0.8 / 1.0 / 4.1 % near-neutral.
